topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I wasn't expecting anything when I walked into the classroom today, and the small, unassuming package sitting on my desk threw me off. I recognized the handwriting on the card instantly—it was from John, a student from a few years back. The room felt smaller as I carefully opened it, unsure what to expect. Inside, a simple book, one we'd discussed in class many times. His note thanked me for the lessons, but the weight of the book seemed heavier, as if it carried more than just the stories printed within. I put it down and stepped back, needing a moment to process, to steady myself before I could truly accept the gift.
